SELECT p.id, p.board_id AS boardId, p.title, p.content, p.author_id AS authorId, m.display_name AS authorDisplayName, p.category_id AS categoryId, bc.name AS categoryName, p.is_secret AS secret, p.secret_password_hash AS secretPasswordHash, p.is_pinned AS pinned, p.comments_locked AS commentsLocked, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.version, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.representative_file_id AS representativeFileId, p.content_document AS contentDocument, p.blinded_at AS blindedAt FROM post p INNER JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id LEFT JOIN board_category bc ON bc.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.board_id = #{boardId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
